items.source: In their AbstractTraceInterceptor.invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log) implementation, subclasses should call the createInvocationTraceName(MethodInvocation) method to create a name for the given trace, including information about the method invocation along with a prefix/suffix.
items.translation: 在它们的AbstractTraceInterceptor.invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log)实现中，子类应调用createInvocationTraceName(MethodInvocation)方法为给定的跟踪创建名称，其中包括有关方法调用的信息以及前缀/后缀。

items.source:
Default is "false", logging the invocation based on the proxy
interface/class name.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，根据代理接口/类名称记录调用日志。

items.source: Create a String name for the given MethodInvocation that can be used for trace/logging purposes. This name is made up of the configured prefix, followed by the fully-qualified name of the method being invoked, followed by the configured suffix.
items.translation: 为给定的MethodInvocation创建一个可用于跟踪/日志记录的String名称。该名称由配置的开头前缀、被调用方法的完全限定名以及配置的结尾后缀组成。

items.source: Return the text that will get appended to the trace data.
items.translation: 返回将附加到跟踪数据的文本。

items.source: Return the text that will get prepended to the trace data.
items.translation: 返回将附加到跟踪数据的前缀文本。
